in_sanskrit.name: शर्विक्षा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्वि (Sharvi) - Goddess Saraswati क्षा (Kshaa) - Grace, knowledge, wisdom

in_hindi.name: शर्विक्षा
in_hindi.meaning: शरदा और सरस्वती के आशिरवाद (Sharada aur Saraswati ke aashirwad)
in_hindi.long_meaning: शर्वि (Sharvi) - शरदा (Goddess of Autumn) क्षा (Kshaa) - आशिरवाद (blessings)

in_tamil.name: ஶர்விக்ஷா
in_tamil.meaning: ஶர்வதியுக்கிற விஜ்ஞானம், ப kennis (Sarvadhiyukkiram Vijjanaam, P pannin)
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஶர்வி (Sharvi) - ஶர்வதி (Goddess of Wealth) க்ஷா (Kshaa) - விஜ்ஜானம் (wisdom, knowledge)

in_telugu.name: శర్విక్షా
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్వి (Sharvi) - శర్వది (Goddess of Wealth) క్షా (Kshaa) - జ్ఞానము (wisdom)

in_marathi.name: Sharviksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharviksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharva, the Goddess of prosperity and knowledge. Sharvi means 'Goddess' and Ksha means 'prosperity'.

in_bengali.name: Sharviksha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sharviksha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Sharva, the Goddess of prosperity and knowledge. Sharvi means 'Goddess' and Ksha means 'prosperity'.
